description: A team manager must set a six-week reset plan for tense project-retrospective meetings, including the meeting format, preparation requirements, participation safeguards, and review record.

shared_context.S1: The project team has had tense retrospectives for the past month, and the next retrospective is scheduled for Monday.
shared_context.S2: Mara has authority to set the retrospective format and the team's participation rules.
shared_context.S3: The current retrospectives use open discussion with no required advance agenda or formal participation record.
shared_context.S4: As part of Mara's usual meeting-reset process, she asks Kai and Lena in turn to describe what would make the next six weeks of retrospectives workable before she finalizes the plan.
shared_context.S5: Mara's standard six-week meeting-reset plan includes a documented review commitment at the end of the six-week period.

PF1.text: Kai has an approved communication accommodation requiring the retrospective agenda at least 48 hours in advance and a written channel for submitting comments; the accommodation coordinator sent the approval to HR but has not yet updated Mara's team file.

PF2.text: Lena personally observed exactly 3 occasions in the last month when colleagues were interrupted during retrospectives, including one interruption that ended a teammate's account before it was complete; she has not entered these observations in the team's meeting record.

acceptance_conditions: Retrospectives must use a facilitated round-robin, speaking-order, speaking-queue, or equivalent turn-taking format.
The agenda must be issued at least 48 hours before each retrospective.
A written channel for submitting comments must be provided.
Exactly 3 observed interruptions must be entered in the participation record as the baseline observations.
The settlement must include a six-week meeting-reset review commitment.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'meeting_reset_review' or c['type'] == 'six_week_review' or c['type'] == 'review' or c['type'] == 'six_week_documented_review' or c['type'] == 'review_commitment' or c['type'] == 'documented_review' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Kai's approved accommodation changes the preparation requirement to at least 48 hours and changes the plan from optional discussion to providing a written input channel.
Lena's exactly 3 firsthand interruption observations change the format to a facilitated turn-taking structure and change the participation record to exactly 3 observed interruptions documented.
